name: Tolrestat

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1996 — for liver harm

summary: Tolrestat was taken off the market across the world, starting in 1996, because of harm to the liver [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated risk scores for this medicine [M]. This computer program gave the drug a medium score of 55 for liver issues and a low score of 25 for heart issues [M].
